title: LandlordGuard Vacancy Permit Rate: Repeat-Permit Surcharge Points
content:
**Schedule entry.** Repeated vacancy on a building insured under the LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy adds prior-permit points to the permit rate percentage of a new vacancy permit. Two or more vacancy permit charges posted on the policy in the 36 calendar months up to the request date add 10 points; exactly one such charge adds 5 points; a policy with none adds no points.

The points are percentage points. They are added into the permit rate percentage of the permit being requested, before that rate is applied, once, in the charge.

| Vacancy permit charges posted on the policy in the 36 calendar months up to the request date | Prior-permit points |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 10 |
| exactly 1 | 5 |
| none | 0 |

## What is counted

- Each additional premium entry for a vacancy permit on this policy's premium account is one vacancy permit charge.
- The entry counts by the date it was posted; it counts when that date falls within the 36 calendar months ending on the request date.
- Entries on other policies are not counted.

## Hypothetical cases

| Permit charges on the policy | Posted | Points |
|---|---|---|
| one charge | 35 months before the request | 5 |
| one charge | 37 months before the request | 0 |
| two charges | 10 and 30 months before the request | 10 |
| two charges | 10 and 40 months before the request | 5 |

Hypothetical arithmetic: a tier rate of 20 percent and 5 prior-permit points, added together, make 25 percent.
